Hi Evan / Alison —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through Brighton's search & recommendation use cases. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum: 

What we heard
- Primary goal: reduce search latency for personalized recommendations and cut per-embedding cost for nightly re-ranks.
- Current infra: in-house GPU endpoints + managed embeddings service (avg latency 320ms, cost concerns at 500k queries/day).
- Success metrics: P95 latency < 150ms for interactive queries; 35% cost reduction on embeddings unit spend.

Potential Redwood fit
- Dedicated capacity to guarantee throughput for peak traffic windows (we can reserve capacity and autoscale for spikes).
- Caching + batching recommendation to lower tokens-per-request and reduce cost for re-rank jobs.
- Quantization options for your larger models that preserve quality while lowering GPU memory footprint.

Action items / proposed next steps
1) Technical deep dive (1 hour) with your infra/ML infra lead to validate integration approach — proposed owners: Evan + your infra engineer.
2) Shared eval: we run a 2-week perf/cost eval on a representative dataset (we'll need a small sample and consent).
3) Pricing/ops: I'll put together a rough ARR and Dedicated capacity estimate for your Q3 planning.

If it's helpful, attached the product deck and a short plaintext of my notes from today's call. Can you confirm: 1) who on your team should join the technical deep dive, and 2) whether Brighton is prioritizing a Q3 pilot (yes/no/unsure)?

If I don't hear back, I'll follow up next week to find a time.

Thanks —
Marissa
